governance-core.description: Reproduce core V17 governance, typed-failure, immutable receipt, identity, probability-preservation, and reconciliation boundaries.

typed-failure-preservation.description: Reproduce the V17 rule that concrete scorer/input/acquisition failures remain typed and are not collapsed into MODEL_UNAVAILABLE.

canonical-prop-identity.description: Reproduce canonical player-prop identity handling without current-market or live-bet behavior.

team-probability-preservation.description: Reproduce fitted team-event probability preservation and no-substitution boundaries.

post-deploy-canary-gate.description: Reproduce the deterministic repository contract for post-deploy canary gating.
